## Description

Combine three or more moving averages to identify trend alignment and crossovers.

## Where it may fit

Persistent trends with orderly pullbacks; weak in range-bound/choppy conditions.

## Vehicles

Equity and index ETFs, futures, FX, crypto.

## Required data

Adjusted OHLCV bars; multiple lookback windows; transaction costs.

## Caveats

More filters can reduce trades but also add lag and parameter-mining risk.
